frozen_candidate_root_contribution: aayah = a single, discrete, perceptible token/marker deliberately set forth to be noticed and read as an indicator pointing beyond its bare self, thereby calling an interpreting perceiver to a verdict of recognition or denial. Its dominant (but not root-borne) enrichment is 'evidentiary sign of God's power, veracity or authority'; the medium is unspecified (cosmic phenomenon, past event, person, miracle, private token, man-made monument, or recited scriptural verse).

internal_discovery.candidate_root_contribution: aayah = a single, discrete, perceptible token/marker deliberately set forth to be noticed and read as an indicator pointing beyond its bare self, thereby calling an interpreting perceiver to a verdict of recognition or denial. Its dominant (but not root-borne) enrichment is 'evidentiary sign of God's power, veracity or authority'; the medium is unspecified (cosmic phenomenon, past event, person, miracle, private token, man-made monument, or recited scriptural verse).
internal_discovery.plain_explanation: Across all 382 occurrences the root yields only one word, the noun aayah ('sign'), in singular (86), plural (295) and a single dual (17:12). It never means the reality it points to, only the conspicuous discrete marker that stands for it. The same word covers night/day as cosmic signs, Pharaoh's preserved body, Mary and Jesus, Moses' nine signs, a private token like Zachariah's muteness, the token of Talut's kingship, a man-made vanity monument, and the recited/abrogable verses of scripture. These are settings of one bridged pointer-word, not separate lexemes. The account is graded MODERATE/REPRESENTATIVE rather than STRONG/UNIVERSAL because (a) the vanity-monument at 26:128 strips 'divine/true' out of the bare nucleus, and (b) the scriptural verse-unit use (2:106, 16:101, 11:1, 3:7) is a lexicalized, countable, abrogable nominal specialization in which the 'points-beyond-itself' force is backgrounded.
internal_discovery.layer_separation_note: aayah does NOT denote the referent/truth itself, only its pointer (never God, al-haqq, al-huda directly). It is NOT mass/continuous but discrete and countable (dual 17:12; 'nine aayaat' 17:101; 'one aayah for another' 16:101; 'every aayah' 10:97). It does NOT intrinsically entail divine origin or truth (26:128 human vanity-monument). It does NOT entail uptake or belief (aayaat are belied, mocked, turned from; 10:97, 54:2). It does NOT require pointing to God specifically (a human king's rule 2:248; a private promise 3:41/19:10). It is NOT a linguistic/verbal medium as such (a she-camel 7:73, a corpse 10:92, a building 26:128 all qualify). Its provision is NOT human-commandable (29:50, 6:37).
internal_discovery.strongest_counterexample: 26:128:4:1 -- 'Do you build on every high place an aayah, sporting in vanity (ta'bathuun)?' Here aayah is a human-made vanity monument that is not from God and attests nothing true, pointing only to the builders' arrogance. It defeats any nucleus containing 'divine' or 'true attestation' and forces the root contribution down to the thin semiotic floor: a conspicuous, discrete, set-forth marker meant to be seen and to signify beyond itself. That the account survives only by this thinning is a primary reason it cannot be graded UNIVERSAL.
internal_discovery.strongest_competitor: Two rivals were tested. (1) A more contentful nucleus 'aayah = a DIVINE evidentiary sign furnished by God attesting His truth/power/authority' fits ~381/382 verses more sharply (the min rabbihi / 'inda llah / aayaatinaa framing is near-ubiquitous) and would earn STRONG; it fails only on 26:128 (vanity-monument), but that single material counterexample is enough, under the anti-over-grade rule, to bar promoting 'divine/true' into the root-level nucleus. (2) An unbridged lexical split, aayah1 'sign/portent' vs aayah2 'technical verse of scripture' (abrogable 2:106, substitutable 16:101, 'made precise/detailed' 11:1/41:3, sorted muhkam/mutashaabih 3:7). This is rejected Quran-internally: the two putative classes share morphology and number-behaviour with no seam, share every diagnostic predicate (fassala applied to plagues-as-signs 7:133 AND to verses 41:3; bayyinaat qualifies recited verses 24:1 AND world/mission signs 2:211/7:73; jaa'a / anzala / kadhdhaba bi- attach to both), and the text self-identifies recited verses as a species of sign (29:49 revelation is 'bayyinaat', answered two verses later by demanded miracle-signs 29:50; 2:118 answers a demand for an aayah with 'we have made the aayaat clear'). So the verse-unit use is a bridged lexicalized specialization, not a second lexeme.

internal_discovery.rationale: All three lenses converge that the root contributes exactly one lexeme (noun aayah; no verb, participle, or interrogative/relative ayy anywhere in the 382), and that the referential range is ONE Quran-internally bridged nucleus rather than multiple unbridged classes -- the bridge is demonstrated, not inferred (17:12 dual+singular in one cosmic verse; 29:49-50 and 6:109 use the same word for revelation-sign and demanded miracle-sign in one breath; fassala 7:133/41:3; bayyinaat for verses and for miracles; 41:53 spans cosmic + revealed under one evidentiary purpose). Because the classes bridge, RESISTANT/UNRESOLVED and a multi-class verdict are rejected: research_state=PREFERRED. However the grade is capped at MODERATE/REPRESENTATIVE, following Lens C and the anti-over-grade contract rule, on two grounds: (1) the scriptural verse-unit sub-class (2:106, 16:101, 11:1, 3:7) is a lexicalized, nominal, countable/abrogable specialization where the distinctive semiotic nucleus is backgrounded -- a resistant lexicalized sub-class caps strength at MODERATE and scope at REPRESENTATIVE; (2) the vanity-monument 26:128 materially removes 'divine/true' from the bare nucleus, so the account survives only by thinning and cannot claim UNIVERSAL scope. Lens A's proposed STRONG/BROAD and Lens B's STRONG-structural are not adopted at face value: A and B both concede the verse-unit specialization and that the exact content scope is only REPRESENTATIVE; the honest aggregate keeps the single bridged nucleus (their shared structural finding) but declines STRONG because a coherent lexicalized sub-class persists, which the STRONG bar forbids.

clusters.classification_rationale: Morphology gives no partition: every one of the 382 is pos=N, form=N, qac_verb_form=null, fully inflected for number/case and taking proclitics like an ordinary count noun. Every seam is semantic, not formal, and the semantic seams are Quran-internally bridged (17:12 dual+singular cosmic; 29:49-50 / 6:109 revelation-sign and miracle-sign in one exchange; fassala 7:133 plagues-as-signs = 41:3 verses; bayyinaat for verses 24:1 and miracles 7:73; number is rhetorical, 6:109/29:50 singular aayah answered by plural aayaat). Therefore all occurrences fall in one cluster with disposition CONSISTENT.

Unity data: 17:12:4:1 (dual), 29:49:3:1 with 29:50:5:1, 7:133:8:1 with 41:3:3:1, 7:73:23:1, 41:53:2:1, 2:252:2:1, 10:97:4:1.
counterevidence: 26:128:4:1 -- human-made vanity monument, not from God, attesting nothing true; caps the nucleus at a thin semiotic floor and bars 'divine/true' from the root level.
2:106:4:1 and 16:101:3:1 / 16:101:5:1 -- aayah as an abrogable/substitutable discrete scriptural verse-unit (lexicalized nominal specialization where the points-beyond-itself force is backgrounded).

11:1:4:1 and 3:7:7:1 -- aayah as a countable/categorizable constituent of the text (uhkimat aayaatuhu; muhkamaat vs mutashaabihaat), the lexicalized verse-unit use that caps strength at MODERATE and scope at REPRESENTATIVE.

reconciliation.rationale: Resistance is only to the over-loaded nucleus. Once the root contribution is stated at its narrowest ('conspicuous discrete set-forth marker that signifies beyond itself') the occurrence is subsumed. Its effect is not to fracture the class but to bar 'divine/true' from the root level, which is recorded as the strongest counterexample and as a driver of the MODERATE/REPRESENTATIVE cap.

The verse/sign split collapses under shared predicates (fassala 7:133 vs 41:3; bayyinaat for verses 24:1 and miracles 7:73; kadhdhaba bi- / anzala on both) and the text self-identifying recited verses as signs (2:252, 29:49). So it is a bridged lexicalized specialization, not an unbridged homonym -- but its lexicalized/nominal character caps the aggregate grade at MODERATE/REPRESENTATIVE.

adversarial_verification.notes: The adversarial verse/sign split was actively pursued and collapsed under shared predicates (fassala 7:133/41:3; bayyinaat 24:1/7:73; kadhdhaba bi-/anzala on both; self-identification 2:252, 29:49-50), so the single bridged nucleus is not refuted (research_state=PREFERRED). But the core does not pass a clean UNIVERSAL falsification: the vanity-monument 26:128 and the lexicalized verse-unit tokens (2:106, 16:101, 11:1, 3:7) resist the contentful nucleus and cap the grade. Because the core holds while these occurrences resist, status is NOT_RUN with the resisting occurrences recorded, rather than PASSED (which would require failing_occurrences=[]).

It defeats any nucleus containing 'divine' or 'true attestation' and forces the root contribution down to the thin semiotic floor: a conspicuous, discrete, set-forth marker meant to be seen and to signify beyond itself. That the account survives only by this thinning is a primary reason it cannot be graded UNIVERSAL.

occurrence_dispositions.preliminary_note: Morphology gives no partition: every one of the 382 is pos=N, form=N, qac_verb_form=null, fully inflected for number/case and taking proclitics like an ordinary count noun. Every seam is semantic, not formal, and the semantic seams are Quran-internally bridged (17:12 dual+singular cosmic; 29:49-50 / 6:109 revelation-sign and miracle-sign in one exchange; fassala 7:133 plagues-as-signs = 41:3 verses; bayyinaat for verses 24:1 and miracles 7:73; number is rhetorical, 6:109/29:50 singular aayah answered by plural aayaat). Therefore all occurrences fall in one cluster with disposition CONSISTENT.
occurrence_dispositions.reconciliation_rationale: The verse/sign split collapses under shared predicates (fassala 7:133 vs 41:3; bayyinaat for verses 24:1 and miracles 7:73; kadhdhaba bi- / anzala on both) and the text self-identifying recited verses as signs (2:252, 29:49). So it is a bridged lexicalized specialization, not an unbridged homonym -- but its lexicalized/nominal character caps the aggregate grade at MODERATE/REPRESENTATIVE.

Every seam is semantic, not formal, and the semantic seams are Quran-internally bridged (17:12 dual+singular cosmic; 29:49-50 / 6:109 revelation-sign and miracle-sign in one exchange; fassala 7:133 plagues-as-signs = 41:3 verses; bayyinaat for verses 24:1 and miracles 7:73; number is rhetorical, 6:109/29:50 singular aayah answered by plural aayaat). Therefore all occurrences fall in one cluster with disposition CONSISTENT.
occurrence_dispositions.candidate_semantic_interpretation: One noun aayah in singular (86), plural (295) and dual (1). A discrete, perceptible, conspicuously set-forth marker/token functioning as an indicator that points beyond its bare self and calls for a verdict of recognition or denial. Referential settings (cosmic phenomenon, past-event monument, person/event, prophetic miracle, demanded/withheld sign, private confirmatory token, recited/abrogable scriptural verse) are bridged applications of this one nucleus, not separate lexemes.

independent_verification: Three independent lenses (A, B, C) each read all 382, all confirmed a single lexeme with a Quran-internally bridged range and identified 26:128 as the decisive counterexample and the verse-unit use as the lexicalized specialization; the aggregate adopts Lens C's contract-grounded MODERATE/REPRESENTATIVE cap over Lens A/B's STRONG.
candidate_root_contribution: aayah = a single, discrete, perceptible token/marker deliberately set forth to be noticed and read as an indicator pointing beyond its bare self, thereby calling an interpreting perceiver to a verdict of recognition or denial. Its dominant (but not root-borne) enrichment is 'evidentiary sign of God's power, veracity or authority'; the medium is unspecified (cosmic phenomenon, past event, person, miracle, private token, man-made monument, or recited scriptural verse).

layer_attribution.occurrence_evidence: 382 occurrences, all noun aayah (pos=N, form=N, qac_verb_form=null): singular 86, plural 295, dual 1 (17:12). Frame counts: ~104 bi-aayaat verdict tokens, ~54 evidential 'inna fii dhaalika la-aayah', recitation/sent-down cluster, discerner-tags. Verified against verse_text and word_refs in the packet.
layer_attribution.derivation: The root contributes exactly one lexeme; there is no verb, participle, or other derivative (qac_verb_form null in every case), and no interrogative/relative ayy in the cluster. All semantic work is nominal.
layer_attribution.lexical_class: One noun with a bridged meaning-range. A conventionalized specialization exists (aayah = discrete abrogable scriptural verse-unit: 2:106, 16:101, 11:1, 3:7) that is lexicalized and nominal; it bridges to the nucleus (2:252, 29:49) but caps the grade at MODERATE/REPRESENTATIVE, giving claim_scope_kind=LEXICALIZED_CLASS.
layer_attribution.contextual_relation: The dominant enrichment 'evidentiary sign of God's power/veracity/authority' is supplied contextually (by God being the one who ja'ala/aataa/anzala the aayah, and by min rabbihi / 'inda llah / aayaatinaa framing). It is NOT elevated into the root claim; the root-level nucleus stays at the discrete conspicuous signifying-marker floor, per 26:128.
layer_attribution.reconciliation: Preliminary RESISTANT readings of 26:128 (vanity-monument) and 2:106 (technical verse) were reconciled to CONSISTENT: the first only resists the over-loaded nucleus and is subsumed by the narrowed floor; the second is a bridged lexicalized specialization, not an unbridged homonym. Both are retained as grade-cap drivers.
layer_attribution.unresolved_resistance: No unbridged, predicate-isolated sub-class survived, so there is no persisted multi-class resistance (research_state=PREFERRED). Residual bounded resistance: 26:128 (bars divine/true from the root level) and the lexicalized verse-unit sub-class (backgrounds the pointer nucleus) -- recorded, not resolved away, and jointly responsible for the MODERATE/REPRESENTATIVE grade.

hard_cases.reason: Human-made vanity-monument built in vain sport; not from God, attests nothing true. Strips 'divine/true' from the bare nucleus and forces the thin semiotic floor.

evidence_basis.statement: 26:128:4:1 -- 'Do you build on every high place an aayah, sporting in vanity (ta'bathuun)?' Here aayah is a human-made vanity monument that is not from God and attests nothing true, pointing only to the builders' arrogance. It defeats any nucleus containing 'divine' or 'true attestation' and forces the root contribution down to the thin semiotic floor: a conspicuous, discrete, set-forth marker meant to be seen and to signify beyond itself. That the account survives only by this thinning is a primary reason it cannot be graded UNIVERSAL.

Within one verse the word appears as dual (night+day) and twice as singular construct, all cosmic-sign, then runs into the plural and the scripture-verse use with no formal break -- the decisive datum that number and sense are orthogonal and the nucleus is one.

evidence_basis.statement: 17:12:4:1 is the sole dual in 382 occurrences; 'We made the night and the day two aayaat (aayatayn); We effaced the aayah of the night and made the aayah of the day illuminating' -- dual and singular of the same nucleus in one verse, proving number is rhetorical, not semantic, and supporting the single bridged nucleus.

hard_case_representation.rationale: There is no final-RESISTANT, unbridged occurrence: the cross-class bridge is Quran-internally demonstrated, so the single nucleus is PREFERRED. The genuine hard cases are (a) the vanity-monument 26:128 (ADVERSARIAL_BOUNDARY that bars 'divine/true' from the root level), (b) the lexicalized scriptural verse-unit tokens 2:106/16:101/11:1/3:7 (ADVERSARIAL_BOUNDARY / lexicalized specialization that caps the grade at MODERATE/REPRESENTATIVE), and (c) the unique dual 17:12 (STRUCTURAL_ATYPICALITY that positively confirms the single nucleus). Each hard case's statement also appears as the strongest_counterexample or as a cluster/override note.

rejection_condition.challenging_finding: Find a coherent set of aayah occurrences whose meaning is fixed by context to something that shares NO Quran-internal predicate bridge with the pointer nucleus -- e.g. a stable sub-class where aayah denotes a bare physical object with no signifying/attesting function, or where the scriptural verse-unit use can be shown to reject the sign-predicates (never called bayyinaat, never fassala, never believed/denied via bi-aayaat) -- which would force an unbridged multi-class or a genuine lexical split.
rejection_condition.search_location: Test the lexicalized verse-unit tokens 2:106:4:1, 16:101:3:1, 11:1:4:1, 3:7:7:1 against the sign-predicate frames (bayyinaat 24:1; fassala 41:3 vs 7:133; kadhdhaba bi- / anzala; self-identification 2:252, 29:49), and re-examine 26:128:4:1 for any latent signifying function.
rejection_condition.verification_method: Diacritic-normalized collocation and frame audit across all 382 occurrences: does each candidate sub-class occur with the shared predicates (fassala, bayyinaat, jaa'a/atat, anzala, kadhdhaba/kafara bi-, tutlaa) or is it predicate-isolated? Confirm word_refs and verse_text directly in the packet.
rejection_condition.confounder_control: Control for number (singular/dual/plural are orthogonal to sense, 6:109/29:50/17:12), for proclitics (bi-/wa- prefixed variants are the same lexeme, not a contaminant), and exclude interrogative/relative ayy which does not occur in this cluster.
rejection_condition.failure_consequence: If a predicate-isolated, unbridged sub-class is found, the single-nucleus PREFERRED verdict is withdrawn in favour of UNRESOLVED_CLASS_ONLY (multi-class / lexical split); if instead a signifying function is found in 26:128, the cap-driver weakens and the grade could rise toward STRONG.

reopen_conditions: If the scriptural verse-unit tokens (2:106, 16:101, 11:1, 3:7, 41:3) can be shown predicate-isolated from the sign-frames (never bayyinaat, never fassala shared with miracles, never believed/denied via bi-aayaat), reopen as a candidate lexical split / UNRESOLVED_CLASS_ONLY.

If 26:128 (the vanity-monument) is re-read as carrying a genuine signifying/attesting function, reopen to reconsider promoting 'evidentiary/God-pointing' into the root-level nucleus and raising the grade toward STRONG.
If any new dual/singular/plural alternation or a non-N morphological derivative of the root is found that tracks a distinct sense, reopen the single-nucleus and single-lexeme findings.

falsification_evidence.status_rationale: The adversarial verse/sign split was actively pursued and collapsed under shared predicates (fassala 7:133/41:3; bayyinaat 24:1/7:73; kadhdhaba bi-/anzala on both; self-identification 2:252, 29:49-50), so the single bridged nucleus is not refuted (research_state=PREFERRED). But the core does not pass a clean UNIVERSAL falsification: the vanity-monument 26:128 and the lexicalized verse-unit tokens (2:106, 16:101, 11:1, 3:7) resist the contentful nucleus and cap the grade. Because the core holds while these occurrences resist, status is NOT_RUN with the resisting occurrences recorded, rather than PASSED (which would require failing_occurrences=[]).
